fullgame.interpretation: Descriptive saved outcomes. Commitment groups are selected by policy actions; their returns are not causal effects or action EVs. No confidence intervals treat seat rotations as independent. Shown-card examples are a showdown-selected subset, not a population estimate of dealt holdings.

coverage.interpretation: Counts share coarse visible categories; they do not prove nearest-information-set equivalence.
